item.title: So, you think it's cold down here?
item.description: On Monday while we braved 23 degree weather simply getting in our vehicle, crews performed an inspection of the downtown Butler water tower while some 100 feet up. As there was a light breeze, one would have to assume with a wind chill it would be mighty cold.

item.title: BCMH participates in Glaucoma Awareness Month
item.description: January is Glaucoma Awareness MonthRoutine eye exams play a critical role in detecting glaucoma early, often before symptoms are noticeable. Pictured are optometrist Dr. David Miller and visiting ophthalmologist Dr. Cooper Rodgers during a clinic visit at Miller and Miller.We’re grateful to Dr. Rodgers, the team at Miller and Miller, and to the vision care specialists in our community, who help protect patients’ sight.

item.title: Obituary - Gerald LeRoy "Jerry" Shaw
item.description: Gerald LeRoy "Jerry" Shaw, age 83, formerly of Roeland Park, Kansas passed away Wednesday, December 10, 2025. He was born on May 24, 1942 in Kansas City, Missouri the son of Lester and Elsie Marlene Ross. He graduated from Pleasanton High School and attended Park College and the University of Kansas. item.title: Obituary - Patricia Greife
item.description: Patricia Greife, age 84, passed away on Sunday, January 18, 2026 at Clinton Healthcare in Clinton, Missouri. A Memorial service will be held at 2:00 PM on Thursday, January 22, 2026 at the Vansant-Mills Chapel in Clinton with visitation from 1:00-2:00 PM prior to the service. Memorial contributions can be made to the Henry County Memory Fund and may be left in care of the funeral home.Arrangements have been entrusted to Vansant-Mills Funeral Home in Clinton, Missouri.
